NAM.note: No central bank role stated; Namclear is not identified as the central bank.

facts.fact: Namclear has joined the SADC TCIB network operated with PayInc, connecting Namibian banks and authorised non-bank institutions to near-instant cross-border push payments.
Namclear says TCIB services will allow consumers and businesses to send money between Namibia, South Africa and other Common Monetary Area countries.

systems.owner: SADC Bankers' Association, operated by PayInc

NAM.note: Only cross-border bank push payments stated, no retail wallet service.
